description: This file contains authentication service functions for user registration, login, retrieval, and update, utilizing Prisma ORM, bcryptjs for password hashing, and custom error handling.

methods.name: checkUserUniqueness
methods.description: Checks if a user with the given email or username already exists, throws an exception if so.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user after validating input and ensuring uniqueness, returns user data with a token.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, returns user data with a token if successful.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves current user data by ID and returns it with a generated token.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates user data based on provided payload and returns updated user info with a new token.
